# Anabhi Dev

> Personal developer brand based in Bali, Indonesia. Building AI-powered web applications for culinary, lifestyle, and hospitality sectors.

## BaliEats AI

- [BaliEats AI](https://anabhidev.com/BaliEats-AI/): AI-powered Bali culinary assistant. Ask about traditional Balinese food, street food, seafood, vegetarian options, nutritional analysis of food photos, Bali food calendar by ceremony, and restaurant recommendations by area (Ubud, Canggu, Seminyak, Jimbaran, Denpasar). Supports Indonesian, English, Balinese, Javanese, and Mandarin.

## About

- [Anabhi Dev](https://anabhidev.com): Developer profile and projects by Agus, based in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia. Specializes in AI-integrated web applications using Google Apps Script, Gemini API, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase.
